summary: Enhance your expertise in FX markets with our comprehensive training course on trading, derivatives, risk management, and operations. Enroll today!
lede: Foreign exchange markets training explains how currency trading, hedging and settlement work. It is for treasury and finance professionals, traders, risk managers and operations teams who need to manage currency exposure or oversee FX activity. Participants explore spot, forward and swap instruments, assess currency risks, and examine hedging strategies and settlement controls.
audienceIntro: Designed for a diverse group of professionals, this course is tailored to meet the needs of those involved in various aspects of FX trading, risk management, and operations.
audience: Corporate finance managers exposed to multi-currency transactions
Investment and portfolio managers with FX exposure
modules: FX in Corporate and NGO Contexts
FX Market Volatility and Risk Events
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial markets and instruments. Prior experience in finance or related fields is beneficial but not mandatory.
